items.news_title: India disrupts access to popular developer platform Supabase with blocking order
items.news_summary: India blocks access to Supabase, a popular developer platform, causing disruption for tech companies. Government order leads to inconsistent access across networks without clear explanation.

items.news_source: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

items.news_title: India’s cheetah revival gets new boost
items.news_summary: India receives 9 more cheetahs from Botswana, bringing total to 48 as part of ambitious wildlife revival program. Program shows success with 39 cubs born since 2023.

A helicopter carrying a cheetah crate is visible through a window.

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon satirizes the Indian bureaucracy's tendency to claim success through statistics and paperwork by drawing a parallel between official stamps and cheetah spots. items.news_title: 'It's out of our control' - Santner laments loss as New Zealand are left waiting
items.news_summary: New Zealand cricket team loses control of their World Cup fate after defeat to England, must now nervously wait for Pakistan vs Sri Lanka match result.

A cricket ball dangles from string above both their heads, suggesting fate hanging by a thread.
comic.caption: When destiny takes a tea break...
